title: Health meter card backdrop covers the app HUD title (title drawn before the card, every frame when health is on)
evidence: app/main.odin:713: draw_text(app, "Packet Plumber - v2 story 4.3 (network health + win/lose/retry)", 12, 10, 22, p.ink)  |  app/main.odin:776: rnd.draw_health_meter(&app.view, &app.state.health, &app.cat, app.state.health_enabled)  |  app/render/health.odin:35-39: x := (v.win_w - card_w) / 2  /  y := i32(10)  /  rl.DrawRectangle(x - pad, y - pad, card_w + 2 * pad, HEALTH_CARD_H, rl.Color{255, 244, 236, 240})
detail: Title at x=12, size 22, ~63 chars spans past x=420; the meter card backdrop (410..870, y 0..52) draws after it, washing out the title's tail, then "NETWORK HEALTH" overlaps the washout. Permanent in the default session (health on).
recommended_fix: Move the meter card below the title (e.g. y=36) or shorten/move the title; verify visually in the running app — the golden T2s cannot catch this.

title: Crisis banner (dropped to y=68 when health is on) collides with the warning legend lead_s drawn at y=76
evidence: app/main.odin:777-780: banner_y: i32 = 10  /  if app.state.health_enabled {  /  banner_y = 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6  |  app/main.odin:784: rnd.draw_crisis_banner(&app.view, &app.state.crisis, &app.cat, app.state.era, banner_y)  |  app/main.odin:789: draw_text(app, lead_s, 12, 76, 14, p.ink_soft)  |  app/render/crisis.odin:43: ty := y  |  app/render/crisis.odin:69: draw_text_c(v, title, x, ty, 15, p.state_critical)
detail: With health on the banner title row sits at y 68..83, x 420..870; lead_s ("node strain ~30s to critical / ...", y=76, x=12, ~750px wide, drawn after) paints over the banner title whenever a crisis is active.
recommended_fix: Draw lead_s before the banner, or move it below the banner's bottom edge (y >= 68 + banner height); reserve the top-center strip when the meter is live.

title: The banner_y offset formula (10 + HEALTH_CARD_H + 6) is inlined in both app/main.odin and harness/goldens.odin
evidence: app/main.odin:777-780: banner_y: i32 = 10  /  if app.state.health_enabled {  /  banner_y = 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6  |  harness/goldens.odin:60-63: banner_y: i32 = 10  /  if health_on {  /  banner_y = 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6
detail: The meter-card/banner layout contract is duplicated in two files; if the offset changes, both sites must be updated by hand (drift risk between the app HUD and the golden capture).
recommended_fix: Export a render-package helper (e.g. health_banner_y :: proc() -> i32) returning 10 + HEALTH_CARD_H + 6 and call it from both sites.
